model.name: sprintView.displayName
model.description: The TWO render-time formatters of the sprint/task numbering FAMILY (Tron DRY: ONE number attribute per unit, everything derives). (1) sprintDisplayName(sprint) = sprintPrefix(sprint.number) + ': ' + bareTitle = EXACTLY 'Sprint <n>: <title>' (colon, replacing R40.4-phase-1 em-dash). (2) taskDisplayName(task) = 'Task <parent.sprintNumber>.<task.taskIndex>: <bareTitle>' — the sprint part DERIVES via parent->sprint.number, the '.M' is the task's own taskIndex attribute; NO stored 'Task N.M' literal, NO task.sprintName field. ATTRIBUTE-REQUIRED: sprint.number + task.taskIndex are the ONLY stored number homes (declared-not-defaulted). EVERY surface derives at render via these formatters (item-view name slot, detail header, generator.ts:105, sprint-overview-generator.ts:39 [retire S{n} {name}], task rows) — never stores the composed string. Item-view DUP fix (rb-object-item.ts:188): drop the `|| getAttribute('title')` fallback that repeats the name; secondary slot = description only or nothing. EXTENDS sprint-label.ts atom + check-sprint-label.ts (R40.4-phase-2, no new module); SUPERSEDES sprintView.renderLabel d6cb7ddd (phase-1 em-dash). class/method=null — architect wires on build-go. GATES (each stub-must-fail, report-only->strict per R37.3 dual-flip): no-sprint.number RED / name /Sprint\s*\d+/ RED / name /Task\s*\d+\.\d+/ RED / persisted sprintName-or-number on a Task/non-Sprint unit RED / sprint-<n> dir != model.number RED / display built outside sprintDisplayName|taskDisplayName RED / oi-desc==oi-name RED.
